supporting_observations.claim: The domain controller recorded guest.rwong being created by tess.hart at 13:44:55 UTC. The creation event’s subject logon ID matches tess.hart’s network logon to the domain controller from WS-THART-01 shortly beforehand.
The new account was added to the Volunteers group, consistent with the stated help-desk workflow for temporary guest accounts.
The account name guest.rwong and the recorded creator tess.hart align with the organization’s stated temporary-account naming and help-desk creation practices.

known_telemetry_limitations: The provided records show creation and one group addition, but do not provide a complete view of guest.rwong’s group memberships or effective permissions.
The records do not show the account request, approval, intended owner, or business purpose.
claims_not_established: The available records do not establish whether guest.rwong received any additional group memberships or permissions beyond the Volunteers addition shown.
The available records do not establish who requested the account or whether the request was approved.
unrelated_findings: tess.hart launched Remote Desktop to FILE-ORC-01 and established an interactive logon there. This is outside the account-creation activity and differs from the stated practice that remote administration is done from WS-SBYRNE-01; review separately without treating it as evidence that guest.rwong’s creation was malicious. Records: T298-00026, T298-00031, T298-00032.
